create_todo_middleware: create a TodoMiddleware that extends TodoListMiddleware with context-loss detection and premature-exit prevention
detect_todos_in_messages: detect whether any AIMessage in the message history contains a write_todos tool call
format_todo_list: format a list of Todo items into a human-readable string with status and content
inject_context_loss_reminder: inject a todo_reminder HumanMessage when write_todos has been truncated from the context window
prevent_premature_exit: prevent the agent from exiting the loop when incomplete todo items remain by jumping back to the model node
